We are looking for a Network Security Operations Engineer to partner across Infrastructure, Security, Platform, Application, and Operations teams to strengthen the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our technology landscape.
The role will be instrumental in delivering key cybersecurity initiatives related to network segmentation, firewall governance, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, credential security, hardening, and end-of-life (EOL) remediation across on-premises, cloud, data center, office, warehouse, and retail environments.
The Network Security Operations Engineer will be a proactive and self-motivated security professional responsible for supporting and executing security improvement programs, operational controls, and remediation activities across network infrastructure, servers, endpoints, applications, and cloud platforms. The role requires close collaboration with business and technology stakeholders to implement sustainable security controls while maintaining operational stability.
 Responsibilities
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, IAM, Platform, and Application teams to implement and maintain secure network architectures and cybersecurity controls
Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of network segmentation, privileged access pathways, and secure remote administration solutions
Manage firewall governance activities, including firewall rule reviews, risk assessments, remediation of obsolete rules, and validation of business requirements for network access
Drive vulnerability management initiatives by validating scan coverage, coordinating remediation activities, tracking high-risk vulnerabilities, and ensuring closure of security findings
Participate in hardening initiatives by defining, implementing, and enforcing security baselines across network devices, servers, endpoints, and cloud platforms
Identify, assess, and remediate risks associated with End-of-Life (EOL) systems through segmentation, monitoring, privileged access restrictions, and compensating controls
Develop and maintain security documentation, operational procedures, standards, and technical designs
Act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, controls, and best practices and share knowledge across technical teams
Provide operational support and technical leadership during security projects, audits, investigations, and compliance activities
 Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of experience in Network Security, Security Operations, Infrastructure Security, or a related field
Background in enterprise network technologies, including routing, switching, and LAN/WAN
Proficiency in VPN, wireless networking, and network segmentation
Expertise in managing firewalls, firewall policies, and security zones, including access control lists (ACLs) and network security controls
Skills in supporting vulnerability management programs, security remediation initiatives, and security compliance activities
Familiarity with privileged access management (PAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and break-glass processes, as well as identity security and credential management
Knowledge of security hardening frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks and secure baseline management
Understanding of cloud security principles and hybrid infrastructure environments
Competency in security monitoring, logging, and SIEM platforms, along with incident investigation
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the capability to diagnose complex network and security issues end-to-end
Excellent communication skills in English (C1 level) with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams, combined with strong prioritization, risk-management, and problem-solving capabilities
 Nice to have
Relevant certifications such as Fortinet, Cisco CCNA/CCNP Security, or equivalent
